definitions.explanation: Something being completely ruined or made worthless. Used when effort, plans, or something of value is destroyed or wasted.

examples.japanese: せっかく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{台無|だいな}しになった。
examples.english: The carefully made plan was ruined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{台無|だいな}しだ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{台無|だいな}しになってしまった。
examples.english: That one remark completely ruined the fun atmosphere.

notes:
Very often used with せっかく (with effort, specially) to express frustration that something done with care or effort has been wasted. Common patterns: 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{台無|だいな}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (something gets ruined) and 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{台無|だいな}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to ruin something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台無|だいな}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be ruined
- {台無|だいな}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ruin
- せっかく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{台無|だいな}し: the specially prepared ~ is ruined
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{台無|だいな}し: all ruined
